### CONTEXT METADATA BLOCK — CTX-FLOW

CONTEXT ID:          CTX-FLOW  
CANONICAL NAME:      Market Liquidity & Order Flow Analytics  
ARABIC NAME:         تحليل السيولة وتدفقات الأوامر  
CONTEXT CODE:        FLOW  
DOMAIN CLUSTER:      Strategy and Market Intelligence Cluster  
VERSION:             1.0  
STATUS:              Approved  

DOMAIN CLASSIFICATION:  
  Classification:    Core Enabling  
  Justification:     Market Liquidity & Order Flow Analytics manages order book market depth liquidity analytics, volume profile calculations, institutional order flow imbalance tracking (`LiquidityProfile`, `OrderFlowImbalance`), and market impact modeling. It provides liquidity analytics.  

BUSINESS PURPOSE:  
  This context is responsible for analyzing level-2 order book depth, computing liquidity profiles (`LiquidityProfile`), tracking institutional order flow imbalances (`OrderFlowImbalance`), and calculating volume profile distribution metrics.  

SCOPE — WHAT THIS CONTEXT OWNS:  
  - Order book market depth liquidity profile calculations (`LiquidityProfile`).  
  - Institutional buy/sell order flow imbalance ratio tracking (`OrderFlowImbalance`).  
  - Volume At Price (VAP) and Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) profile calculations.  
  - Bid-ask spread dynamics and order book depth resilience metrics.  
  - Detection of abnormal order flow imbalances prior to market moves.  

SCOPE — WHAT THIS CONTEXT DOES NOT OWN:  
  - Raw ticker quote ingestion or order book snapshot storage (owned strictly by `CTX-MKT` / `CTX-PRC`).  
  - Execution routing to external broker APIs (owned strictly by `CTX-EXEC`).  
  - Quantitative macroeconomic indicator tracking (owned strictly by `CTX-MAC`).  

BUSINESS OWNER:  
  Head of Quantitative Order Flow & Market Microstructure Analytics  

PRIMARY ACTORS:  
  Active Trader, Institutional Investor, Quantitative Analyst, Portfolio Manager  

OWNED BUSINESS OBJECTS:  
  - `LiquidityProfile` — Market depth liquidity entity detailing bid/ask volume depth layers, spread, and market impact score.  
  - `OrderFlowImbalance` — Quantitative order flow metric entity tracking institutional buy vs sell volume imbalance ratios.  

OWNED CAPABILITIES:  
  - `AI-REC-003` (Scoped Shared Kernel — Primary order flow aspect owner in CTX-FLOW; quantitative strategy aspect owned by CTX-STRAT. Registered in Appendix A).  

PRODUCED EVENTS:  
  - `FLOW_LIQUIDITY_UPDATED` — Triggered when a stock liquidity profile metric updates.  
  - `IMBALANCE_ALERT_FIRED` — Triggered when an abnormal institutional order flow imbalance is detected.  

CONSUMED EVENTS:  
  - `MKT_ORDERBOOK_UPDATED` — Consumed from `CTX-MKT` to evaluate level-2 market depth snapshots.  
  - `MKT_TICK_RECEIVED` — Consumed from `CTX-PRC` for real-time volume profile calculation.  

UBIQUITOUS LANGUAGE TERMS:  
  - `LiquidityProfile`: Quantitative assessment of order book depth and market impact cost for trade executions (UL Sec 2.1).  
  - `OrderFlowImbalance`: Ratio quantifying asymmetry between aggressive buying vs selling volume in order book.  
  - `VolumeProfile`: Distribution of traded volume across discrete price levels over a trading session.  

BUSINESS RULES OWNED:  
  - Rule 18: Order flow imbalance metrics must calculate within sub-50ms of level-2 market depth updates (BDD Sec 10 Rule 18 SLA).  
  - Rule 21: Abnormal order flow imbalance alerts must trigger when buy/sell volume asymmetry exceeds 3.0x historical baseline (BDD Sec 10 Rule 21).  

DISCOVERY EVIDENCE:  
  - Language Evidence:   YES — `LiquidityProfile` and `OrderFlowImbalance` represent market microstructure concepts distinct from `OrderBook` and `TradingStrategy`.  
  - Rule Evidence:       YES — Rule 18 (sub-50ms order flow calculation SLA) applies explicitly here.  
  - Event Evidence:      YES — Produces `FLOW_LIQUIDITY_UPDATED` and `IMBALANCE_ALERT_FIRED`.  
  - Object Evidence:     YES — Exclusive owner of `LiquidityProfile` and `OrderFlowImbalance` objects.  
  - Lifecycle Evidence:  YES — Order flow metrics update continuously on intraday market tick streams during active trading sessions.  
  - Ownership Evidence:  YES — Accountable owner is Head of Quantitative Order Flow & Market Microstructure Analytics.  
  CONFIRMED EVIDENCE COUNT: 6 / 6  

INTEGRATION DEPENDENCIES:  
  - CTX-MKT: Open Host Service | HARD | Consumes level-2 order book depth snapshots.  
  - CTX-PRC: Customer/Supplier | HARD | Consumes real-time price tick arrivals.  

INTEGRATION CONSUMERS:  
  - CTX-UI: Consumes volume profiles and liquidity heatmaps for active trader charts.  
  - CTX-ALRT: Consumes imbalance alerts to dispatch order flow breach notifications.  

EGX-SPECIFIC NOTES:  
  Analyzes order flow liquidity across EGX liquid equities, adjusting for EGX auction session rules (pre-open, pre-close call auctions).  

REGULATORY CONSIDERATIONS:  
  Market microstructure analytics; zero regulatory execution advice liability.

  Phase 1 (EGX Target)

[BOUNDARY JUSTIFICATION]  
  Why this is NOT part of CTX-MKT (Market Data Execution):  
    Microstructure Metrics vs Raw Quote Ingestion Distinction:  
      `CTX-FLOW` (Order Flow Analytics) computes high-level quantitative liquidity metrics (`LiquidityProfile`), institutional order flow imbalance ratios (`OrderFlowImbalance`), and volume profiles.  
      `CTX-MKT` (Market Data) manages raw level-2 order book depth ingestion, ticker symbol definitions, and exchange trading session statuses.  
    Language difference: `LiquidityProfile` is an analytical market depth metric; `OrderBook` is a raw bid/ask level container.  
    Rule difference: Rule 18 (sub-50ms order flow calculation SLA) vs market quote ingestion rules.  
    Object difference: OWNS `LiquidityProfile` and `OrderFlowImbalance`; does NOT own `OrderBook` or `MarketTick`.  
    Event difference: Produces `FLOW_LIQUIDITY_UPDATED`; does NOT produce `MKT_ORDERBOOK_UPDATED`.  

[BUSINESS INVARIANTS]  
  INV-01: Order flow imbalance metrics MUST be computed strictly over verified exchange level-2 market depth snapshots (Rule 18 SLA).  
    Business Rationale: Ensures mathematical integrity of institutional order flow imbalance ratios.  
    Enforcement Mechanism: Mandatory snapshot depth verifier before imbalance calculation.  
    Violation Consequence: Imbalance calculation dropped if depth data is corrupted.  
  INV-02: Liquidity profile estimations MUST adjust for EGX market auction sessions (pre-open, pre-close call auctions) vs continuous trading sessions.  
    Business Rationale: Prevents call auction order accumulation from skewing continuous trading liquidity profiles.  
    Enforcement Mechanism: Trading session status filter in LiquidityProfile engine.  
    Violation Consequence: Call auction order data isolated from continuous profile.  
  INV-03: Institutional order flow imbalance alerts MUST fire only when buy/sell volume asymmetry exceeds 3.0x historical 30-day baseline (Rule 21).  
    Business Rationale: Suppresses false positive alerts during normal market noise.  
    Enforcement Mechanism: Automated 3.0x baseline threshold validator.  
    Violation Consequence: Imbalance alert suppressed.

### CONTEXT METADATA BLOCK — CTX-CROSS

CONTEXT ID:          CTX-CROSS  
CANONICAL NAME:      Cross-Market Spread & GDR Arbitrage Analysis  
ARABIC NAME:         تحليل الفروق السعرية بين الأسواق وشهادات الإيداع الدولية  
CONTEXT CODE:        CROSS  
DOMAIN CLUSTER:      Market Intelligence Cluster  
VERSION:             1.0  
STATUS:              Approved  

DOMAIN CLASSIFICATION:  
  Classification:    Core Differentiating  
  Justification:     Cross-Market Spread & GDR Arbitrage Analysis manages tracking of valuation spreads, currency conversion effects, and lead-lag relationships between dual-listed equities (e.g. CIB LSE GDRs vs EGX CIB local shares) (`CrossMarketSpread`, `GDRArbitrageRatio`). It provides cross-market price spread intelligence.  

BUSINESS PURPOSE:  
  This context is responsible for monitoring valuation spreads between dual-listed equities (`CrossMarketSpread`), calculating Global Depositary Receipt (GDR) arbitrage ratios (`GDRArbitrageRatio`), and tracking international price lead-lag signals.  

SCOPE — WHAT THIS CONTEXT OWNS:  
  - Tracking valuation spreads between local Egyptian equities and international GDR listings (`CrossMarketSpread`).  
  - GDR arbitrage ratio calculations converting foreign currency prices (USD/GBP) to EGP (`GDRArbitrageRatio`).  
  - Cross-market lead-lag signal analytics evaluating international market influence on EGX open.  
  - Disclosing market friction disclaimers (FX conversion fees, cross-border settlement costs).  
  - Monitoring foreign exchange rate impact on dual-listed equity spreads.  

SCOPE — WHAT THIS CONTEXT DOES NOT OWN:  
  - Foreign exchange spot rate execution or FX declared rate management (owned strictly by `CTX-FX`).  
  - International trade order routing or cross-border execution (owned strictly by `CTX-GLOBAL` / `CTX-EXEC`).  
  - Traditional single-exchange market price tick ingestion (owned strictly by `CTX-PRC`).  

BUSINESS OWNER:  
  Head of Cross-Market & Arbitrage Quantitative Intelligence  

PRIMARY ACTORS:  
  Active Trader, Institutional Investor, Quantitative Analyst, Portfolio Manager  

OWNED BUSINESS OBJECTS:  
  - `CrossMarketSpread` — Valuation spread entity detailing price difference between local share and foreign GDR in EGP terms.  
  - `GDRArbitrageRatio` — Theoretical arbitrage metric detailing conversion ratio, implied FX rate, and spread percentage.  

OWNED CAPABILITIES:  
  - `RES-SEC-002` (BCM Sec 3 Domain 2) — Cross-Market Spread Analysis (Primary Owner).  

PRODUCED EVENTS:  
  - `CROSS_SPREAD_CALCULATED` — Triggered when a dual-listed cross-market spread metric updates.  
  - `GDR_ARBITRAGE_ALERT_FIRED` — Triggered when a GDR arbitrage spread breaches historical threshold bounds.  

CONSUMED EVENTS:  
  - `MKT_TICK_RECEIVED` — Consumed from `CTX-PRC` for local and foreign equity price ticks.  
  - `FX_RATE_DECLARED` — Consumed from `CTX-FX` for declared foreign exchange conversion rates.  

UBIQUITOUS LANGUAGE TERMS:  
  - `CrossMarketSpread`: Price discrepancy between an equity listed on EGX and its corresponding international GDR (UL Sec 2.1).  
  - `GDRArbitrageRatio`: Mathematical ratio converting international GDR price to equivalent local share price in EGP.  
  - `MarketFriction`: Transaction costs, FX conversion spreads, and settlement delays reducing net arbitrage profits.  

BUSINESS RULES OWNED:  
  - Rule 3.2: Cross-market spread alerts MUST NOT be presented as guaranteed arbitrage execution opportunities; MUST carry an explicit market friction disclaimer warning of FX rate fluctuations and cross-border fees (BDD Sec 10 Rule 3.2 & Constitution Principle 3.2).  
  - Rule 12: GDR arbitrage ratio calculations MUST convert foreign listing prices (USD/GBP) to EGP using real-time declared FX rates from `CTX-FX` (BDD Sec 10 Rule 12).  

DISCOVERY EVIDENCE:  
  - Language Evidence:   YES — `CrossMarketSpread` and `GDRArbitrageRatio` represent cross-border dual-listing concepts distinct from `MarketTick` and `ExchangeRate`.  
  - Rule Evidence:       YES — Rule 3.2 (explicit market friction disclaimer for arbitrage alerts) applies explicitly here.  
  - Event Evidence:      YES — Produces `CROSS_SPREAD_CALCULATED` and `GDR_ARBITRAGE_ALERT_FIRED`.  
  - Object Evidence:     YES — Exclusive owner of `CrossMarketSpread` and `GDRArbitrageRatio` objects.  
  - Lifecycle Evidence:  YES — Cross-market spreads update continuously across overlapping international trading hours (LSE/EGX sessions).  
  - Ownership Evidence:  YES — Accountable owner is Head of Cross-Market & Arbitrage Quantitative Intelligence.  
  CONFIRMED EVIDENCE COUNT: 6 / 6  

INTEGRATION DEPENDENCIES:  
  - CTX-PRC: Customer/Supplier | HARD | Consumes local and international equity price ticks.  
  - CTX-FX: Open Host Service | HARD | Consumes real-time FX conversion rates.  

INTEGRATION CONSUMERS:  
  - CTX-UI: Consumes cross-market spreads and GDR arbitrage ratios for active trader views.  
  - CTX-ALRT: Consumes arbitrage alerts to dispatch cross-market breach notifications.  

EGX-SPECIFIC NOTES:  
  Tracks major EGX dual-listed equities (e.g. Commercial International Bank CIB LSE GDRs, EFG Hermes GDRs), converting London prices to EGP equivalent.  

REGULATORY CONSIDERATIONS:  
  Discloses cross-market spreads as analytical market intelligence; Tradeora does NOT provide guaranteed cross-border arbitrage execution in Phase 1.  

CURRENT STATE:  
  Phase 1 (EGX Target)  

FUTURE EVOLUTION:  
  Will expand in Phase 2 to support regional MENA dual-listings (Saudi/UAE cross-listings) and automated cross-border execution routing in Phase 3.

    Enforcement Mechanism: Real-time FX converter validator on GDRArbitrageRatio calculation.  
    Violation Consequence: Arbitrage ratio calculation rejected if FX rate is stale (> 5 minutes).

    Business Rationale: Guarantees ratio math accuracy for dual-listed equity calculations.  
    Enforcement Mechanism: Mandatory depositary bank ratio table verifier.  
    Violation Consequence: Calculation held if conversion ratio is unverified.

[BOUNDARY JUSTIFICATION]  
  Why this is NOT part of CTX-MEDIA (Financial Media Ingestion):  
    Official Regulatory Filing vs Unofficial News Media Distinction:  
      `CTX-DISCLOSURE` (Regulatory Disclosures) manages official EGX/FRA corporate filings (`CorporateFiling`) and price-sensitive material event announcements (`MaterialDisclosure`) carrying strict legal compliance weight.  
      `CTX-MEDIA` (Media Ingestion) manages informal news wire feeds, publisher articles, and press wire items (`MediaFeed`, `PressRelease`, `WireItem`).  
    Language difference: `CorporateFiling` is an official legal regulatory submission; `WireItem` is an informal media news article.  
    Rule difference: Rule 9 (sub-60-second disclosure indexing SLA) vs Rule 8 (publisher link retention).  
    Object difference: OWNS `CorporateFiling` and `MaterialDisclosure`; does NOT own `MediaFeed` or `WireItem`.  
    Event difference: Produces `DISCLOSURE_FILED`; does NOT produce `MEDIA_ARTICLE_INGESTED`.  

[BUSINESS INVARIANTS]  
  INV-01: Corporate regulatory filings MUST be indexed and parsed into disclosure search databases within sub-60-seconds of official EGX / FRA publication timestamp (Rule 9 SLA).  
    Business Rationale: Ensures investors receive immediate access to price-sensitive official announcements.  
    Enforcement Mechanism: Mandatory disclosure processing SLA performance validator.  
    Violation Consequence: Indexing SLA breach log flagged.  
  INV-02: FRA material disclosure events MUST trigger immediate portfolio impact assessment alerts to all users holding the affected stock (Rule 18).  
    Business Rationale: Protects investors by notifying them of price-sensitive events impacting their active holdings.  
    Enforcement Mechanism: Mandatory portfolio impact evaluator on MaterialDisclosure creation.  
    Violation Consequence: Portfolio alert dispatched immediately.  
  INV-03: Corporate filing document URIs MUST point strictly to immutable official exchange document storage vaults.  
    Business Rationale: Guarantees tamper-evident disclosure document preservation.  
    Enforcement Mechanism: Document URI immutability verifier.  
    Violation Consequence: Filing registration rejected if URI is mutable.

The following relationship catalog documents all strategic and operational relationships between Tradeora Bounded Contexts. Every relationship conforms to one of the 8 canonical Domain-Driven Design integration patterns (Evans 2003) and communicates strictly via immutable Domain Events defined in `docs/DOMAIN_EVENT_CATALOG.md`.

### CLUSTER 1 INTERNAL RELATIONSHIPS

RELATIONSHIP ID:       REL-001  
UPSTREAM CONTEXT:      CTX-CAL — Exchange Trading Calendar  
DOWNSTREAM CONTEXT:    CTX-SES — Market Session State Management  
RELATIONSHIP PATTERN:  Customer/Supplier  
BUSINESS RATIONALE:    Market session transitions (e.g. Pre-Open to Continuous Trading) depend on official trading calendar operational schedules, public holidays, and scheduled half-day sessions.  
INTEGRATION MECHANISM: `CAL_CALENDAR_PUBLISHED`, `CAL_SESSION_SCHEDULED`, `CAL_HOLIDAY_DECLARED`  
DEPENDENCY STRENGTH:   HARD  
UPSTREAM OBLIGATIONS:  Guarantees publication of finalized exchange calendars at least 30 days prior to annual start and immediate broadcast of emergency holiday declarations.  
DOWNSTREAM PROTECTIONS: Fallback to standard exchange weekday schedule if calendar feed update is temporarily delayed.  
BUSINESS IMPACT IF BROKEN: Market session states fail to transition, halting automated order processing and real-time session status indicators.  
EGX-SPECIFIC NOTES:    Enforces Sunday–Thursday Egyptian business week schedule and Ramadan adjusted trading hours.  

---

RELATIONSHIP ID:       REL-002  
UPSTREAM CONTEXT:      CTX-EXCH — Exchange Market Connectivity  
DOWNSTREAM CONTEXT:    CTX-SEC — Financial Instrument Master & Listing  
RELATIONSHIP PATTERN:  Customer/Supplier  
BUSINESS RATIONALE:    Exchange connectivity feeds supply raw listing notifications, ISIN additions, and official trading symbol updates to populate the Security Master directory.  
INTEGRATION MECHANISM: `INST_LISTING_ANNOUNCED`, `INST_SYMBOL_RECLASSIFIED`, `INST_DELISTING_NOTIFIED`  
DEPENDENCY STRENGTH:   HARD  
UPSTREAM OBLIGATIONS:  Guarantees real-time broadcast of official EGX instrument additions, suspensions, and ticker adjustments.  
DOWNSTREAM PROTECTIONS: Validation layer rejects malformed ISIN format or duplicate symbol registrations.  
BUSINESS IMPACT IF BROKEN: New stock listings cannot be searched or tracked on Tradeora, preventing user portfolio tracking of newly listed securities.  
EGX-SPECIFIC NOTES:    Maps EGX Unified Code numbers alongside international ISIN identifiers.  

---

RELATIONSHIP ID:       REL-003  
UPSTREAM CONTEXT:      CTX-SEC — Financial Instrument Master & Listing  
DOWNSTREAM CONTEXT:    CTX-MKT — Order Book & Depth Ingestion  
RELATIONSHIP PATTERN:  Customer/Supplier  
BUSINESS RATIONALE:    Order book depth stream processing requires verified master instrument reference definitions to validate target security IDs prior to depth ingestion.  
INTEGRATION MECHANISM: `INST_MASTER_UPDATED`, `INST_TRADING_HALTED`, `INST_TRADING_RESUMED`  
DEPENDENCY STRENGTH:   HARD  
UPSTREAM OBLIGATIONS:  Guarantees sub-second distribution of security master status changes, trading halts, and symbol suspensions.  
DOWNSTREAM PROTECTIONS: Filters out raw order book ticks for unknown or unverified instrument IDs.  
BUSINESS IMPACT IF BROKEN: Order book depth data streams fail validation, disabling Level-2 market depth visualization.  
EGX-SPECIFIC NOTES:    Validates EGX sector classification codes attached to instrument master records.  

---

RELATIONSHIP ID:       REL-004  
UPSTREAM CONTEXT:      CTX-MKT — Order Book & Depth Ingestion  
DOWNSTREAM CONTEXT:    CTX-PRC — Real-Time Price Stream Processing  
RELATIONSHIP PATTERN:  Customer/Supplier  
BUSINESS RATIONALE:    Real-time price calculations (VWAP, OHLCV aggregates, bid-ask midpoints) require continuous ingestion of raw Level-1 quotes and Level-2 order book depth events.  
INTEGRATION MECHANISM: `MKT_PRICE_TICK_RECEIVED`, `MKT_ORDER_BOOK_UPDATED`, `MKT_TRADE_EXECUTED`  
DEPENDENCY STRENGTH:   HARD  
UPSTREAM OBLIGATIONS:  Guarantees sub-10ms distribution of raw quote ticks and order book updates during active trading hours.  
DOWNSTREAM PROTECTIONS: Anti-Spike price filter rejects corrupted tick values exceeding maximum circuit breaker bounds (+/- 20%).  
BUSINESS IMPACT IF BROKEN: Real-time price chart updates and live stock quotes freeze across all user interface views.  
EGX-SPECIFIC NOTES:    Processes EGX main market trades alongside Nilex small-cap market tick streams.  

---

RELATIONSHIP ID:       REL-005  
UPSTREAM CONTEXT:      CTX-CORP — Corporate Actions & Adjustments  
DOWNSTREAM CONTEXT:    CTX-PRC — Real-Time Price Stream Processing  
RELATIONSHIP PATTERN:  Customer/Supplier  
BUSINESS RATIONALE:    Corporate action events (stock splits, cash dividends, bonus shares, capital reductions) mandate historical price series adjustments (ex-rights / ex-dividend prices).  
INTEGRATION MECHANISM: `CORP_ACTION_ANNOUNCED`, `CORP_DIVIDEND_DECLARED`, `CORP_SPLIT_EXECUTED`  
DEPENDENCY STRENGTH:   HARD  
UPSTREAM OBLIGATIONS:  Guarantees delivery of verified corporate action adjustment factors before ex-date market open.  
DOWNSTREAM PROTECTIONS: Retains unadjusted raw historical price series alongside adjusted series for audit verification.  
BUSINESS IMPACT IF BROKEN: Stock price charts show false downward price spikes on ex-dividend/split dates, corrupting technical analysis charts.  
EGX-SPECIFIC NOTES:    Adjusts EGX historical prices for capital increases via free bonus share distributions.

RELATIONSHIP ID:       REL-006  
UPSTREAM CONTEXT:      CTX-STR — Market Structure & Regulations  
DOWNSTREAM CONTEXT:    CTX-SES — Market Session State Management  
RELATIONSHIP PATTERN:  Customer/Supplier  
BUSINESS RATIONALE:    Regulatory market structure rules govern session behavior, including automatic circuit breaker halts when index volatility thresholds (+/- 5%, +/- 10%) are triggered.  
INTEGRATION MECHANISM: `REG_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIGGERED`, `REG_LIMIT_PRICE_CHANGED`, `REG_SHORT_SELL_BAN_ISSUED`  
DEPENDENCY STRENGTH:   HARD  
UPSTREAM OBLIGATIONS:  Guarantees immediate event broadcast when EGX regulatory volatility thresholds are breached.  
DOWNSTREAM PROTECTIONS: Immediate state override transitioning active trading session to Halted mode.  
BUSINESS IMPACT IF BROKEN: Market session fails to enforce regulatory circuit breaker halts, violating FRA regulatory requirements.

BUSINESS RATIONALE:    Critical risk limit breach events bypass standard alert evaluation queues to trigger immediate emergency notification dispatch.  
INTEGRATION MECHANISM: `RISK_CRITICAL_BREACH_DECLARED`, `RISK_MARGIN_CALL_ISSUED`  
DEPENDENCY STRENGTH:   HARD  
UPSTREAM OBLIGATIONS:  Guarantees immediate high-priority publishing of critical risk breach events.  
DOWNSTREAM PROTECTIONS: Priority dispatch channel overrides user quiet hours settings for critical risk emergencies.  
BUSINESS IMPACT IF BROKEN: Emergency risk alerts are delayed by standard notification queues, increasing potential portfolio loss.  
EGX-SPECIFIC NOTES:    Dispatches SMS alerts for urgent margin maintenance calls under Egyptian brokerage regulations.

### CONTEXT CONNECTIVITY & INTERACTION ANALYSIS

#### 1. Contexts with Highest Connectivity (Enterprise Hubs)
- **`CTX-IDN` (Identity & Access Control)**: Upstream Open Host Service (`OHS`) to 100% of platform contexts. Every user-facing request requires identity verification.
- **`CTX-ENT` (Client Entitlements)**: Upstream Anti-Corruption Layer (`ACL`) protecting capability access across 100% of contexts.
- **`CTX-AUD` (System Audit Logging)**: Universal downstream Conformist (`CON`). Ingests audit log events from all 48 contexts without upstream dependencies modifying audit logic.
- **`CTX-PRC` (Real-Time Price Stream Processing)**: Core operational hub supplying price tick data to 12 downstream analytics, portfolio, risk, and alert contexts.
- **`CTX-DATA` (Data Pipeline Operations)**: Universal Published Language (`PL`) supplier distributing ETL batch datasets across platform ingestion contexts.

#### 2. Most Isolated Contexts (Periphery Leaf Contexts)
- **`CTX-FEEDBACK` (User Feedback & NPS)**: Low connectivity (2 incoming/outgoing links). Receives user surveys; exports aggregated NPS metrics to observability.
- **`CTX-COMM` (Investor Community)**: Isolated social engagement context. Consumes user identity and dispatch services; emits community posts.
- **`CTX-TAX` (Tax Lot Accounting)**: Specialized accounting context. Consumes position fill records; exports capital gains accounting tax schedules.

#### 3. Unexpected & Critical Dependency Paths
- **Corporate Action Price Cascade**: `CTX-CORP` → `CTX-PRC` → `CTX-PORT` → `CTX-RISK`. A dividend or split announcement in `CTX-CORP` adjusts price series in `CTX-PRC`, which immediately triggers NAV recalculation in `CTX-PORT` and updates concentration risk metrics in `CTX-RISK`.
- **Disclosure Portfolio Alert Cascade**: `CTX-DISCLOSURE` → `CTX-PORT` → `CTX-ALRT` → `CTX-NOTIF`. An official FRA regulatory filing in `CTX-DISCLOSURE` triggers portfolio holding evaluation in `CTX-PORT`, generating instant high-priority alerts dispatched via `CTX-NOTIF`.

## SECTION 3 — SHARED KERNEL REGISTRY
## القسم 3 — سجل النواة المشتركة (Shared Kernel Registry)

The following registry documents all **Scoped Shared Kernel** elements across Tradeora Bounded Contexts. A Shared Kernel represents an explicit, governance-approved joint agreement between specific contexts to share a core business model structure.

---

### SHARED KERNEL 1: MONEY & CURRENCY VALUE KERNEL

KERNEL ELEMENT NAME:  `MoneyAndCurrencyValue`  
SHARED BETWEEN:       `CTX-PORT`, `CTX-PRC`, `CTX-FX`, `CTX-TAX`  
WHAT IS SHARED:       The structural value representation of financial monetary amounts, including monetary amount value, ISO-4217 currency code (`EGP`, `USD`, `EUR`), scale precision (4 decimal places), and currency conversion rounding rules.  
WHY SHARED:           Prevents floating-point rounding errors and currency mismatch discrepancies when calculating NAV valuations, stock prices, FX conversions, and tax capital gains across contexts.  
CHANGE PROTOCOL:      Any modification to currency precision, rounding modes, or monetary value representation requires joint approval from the Lead Portfolio Architect and Lead Risk Architect via formal RFC.  
RISK IF DIVERGES:     Currency rounding divergence causes NAV accounting imbalances and false tax capital gain calculations.  

---

### SHARED KERNEL 2: MARKET IDENTIFIER & TICKER REFERENCE KERNEL

KERNEL ELEMENT NAME:  `MarketIdentifierReference`  
SHARED BETWEEN:       `CTX-SEC`, `CTX-EXCH`, `CTX-MKT`, `CTX-PRC`  
WHAT IS SHARED:       Canonical instrument identification reference structure, combining ISIN (`EG600041C018`), EGX Symbol (`COMI`), MIC Exchange Code (`XCHE`), and Country ISO (`EG`).  
WHY SHARED:           Guarantees unambiguous instrument identification across exchange connectivity, order book depth ingestion, price stream processing, and security master directories.  
CHANGE PROTOCOL:      Changes to instrument reference structures require joint sign-off from Head of Market Data Ingestion and Security Master Product Owner.  
RISK IF DIVERGES:     Order book ticks match wrong security master entries, corrupting live stock price charts.  

---

### SHARED KERNEL 3: MARKET TIME & TRADING SESSION CALENDAR KERNEL

KERNEL ELEMENT NAME:  `MarketTradingTimeSession`  
SHARED BETWEEN:       `CTX-CAL`, `CTX-SES`, `CTX-PRC`, `CTX-PORT`  
WHAT IS SHARED:       Temporal business session structure, including Market Operating Date, Session Phase Enum (`PRE_OPEN`, `CONTINUOUS_TRADING`, `CALL_AUCTION`, `CLOSED`), and Timezone Offset (`Africa/Cairo`).  
WHY SHARED:           Ensures synchronized session phase awareness across pricing engines, trading session controllers, and portfolio NAV closing locks.  
CHANGE PROTOCOL:      Modifications require joint approval from Market Structure Architect and Operations Governance Lead.  
RISK IF DIVERGES:     Pricing context processes ticks after market close or portfolio context locks NAV valuation during active trading session.  

---

### SHARED KERNEL 4: QUANTITATIVE SIGNAL & MODEL RATING CONTRACT KERNEL

KERNEL ELEMENT NAME:  `QuantitativeSignalRatingContract`  
SHARED BETWEEN:       `CTX-SIG`, `CTX-STRAT`, `CTX-REC`, `CTX-CONF`  
WHAT IS SHARED:       Standardized quantitative signal rating enum (`STRONG_BUY`, `BUY`, `NEUTRAL`, `SELL`, `STRONG_SELL`), score normalization scale (-1.00 to +1.00), and confidence interval structure.  
WHY SHARED:           Allows recommendation engines, quantitative signal generators, and backtesting engines to exchange structured quantitative signals cleanly.  
CHANGE PROTOCOL:      Requires joint approval from Head of Quantitative Research and Lead AI Architecture Engineer.  
RISK IF DIVERGES:     AI recommendation engine misinterprets quantitative signal polarity scores, generating incorrect recommendation proposals.  

---

### SHARED KERNEL 5: SYSTEM GOVERNANCE SECURITY KEY & TOKEN KERNEL

KERNEL ELEMENT NAME:  `SystemSecurityKeyTokenContract`  
SHARED BETWEEN:       `CTX-SEC-INFRA`, `CTX-IDN`, `CTX-API`  
WHAT IS SHARED:       Cryptographic token verification structure, signature algorithms (Ed25519), token expiration format, and KMS key identifier headers.  
WHY SHARED:           Ensures uniform authentication token validation across API Gateway, Identity context, and Infrastructure KMS Security context.  
CHANGE PROTOCOL:      Requires unanimous approval from Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and Principal Infrastructure Architect.  
RISK IF DIVERGES:     API Gateway fails to validate valid identity tokens, causing system-wide authentication lockout.

### 5.2 FOUNDATIONAL CONTEXTS (CORE PLATFORM BASELINE)

The following 10 contexts constitute Tradeora's **Foundational Platform Infrastructure**. They must be built, deployed, and stabilized first in Phase 1 before downstream analytical or intelligence contexts can operate:

1. **`CTX-IDN` (Identity & Access Control)** — Universal identity provider.
2. **`CTX-ENT` (Client Entitlements)** — Access authorization guard.
3. **`CTX-SEC-INFRA` (KMS Security)** — Cryptographic Key Management.
4. **`CTX-DATA` (Data Pipeline ETL)** — Core ingestion framework.
5. **`CTX-API` (API Gateway)** — Routing and rate-limiting gateway.
6. **`CTX-SEC` (Security Master)** — Financial instrument reference directory.
7. **`CTX-CAL` (Trading Calendar)** — Market schedule baseline.
8. **`CTX-SES` (Session Management)** — Real-time market state control.
9. **`CTX-PRC` (Price Stream Processing)** — Real-time quote tick hub.
10. **`CTX-AUD` (System Audit Logging)** — Compliance audit logging.

---

### 5.3 CRITICAL DEPENDENCY CHAINS

The 10 most critical business dependency chains in Tradeora:

1. **Real-Time Quote Streaming Chain**: `CTX-EXCH` → `CTX-MKT` → `CTX-PRC` → `CTX-UI`  
   *Significance*: Powers live stock quotes and price charts across all user applications.  
   *Failure Impact*: Complete freeze of real-time price displays across the platform.

2. **AI Recommendation Explainability Chain (MANDATORY)**: `CTX-SIG` → `CTX-REC` → `CTX-EXPL` → `CTX-ASSIST`  
   *Significance*: Enforces non-negotiable AI explainability mandate (Principle 3.1 & Rule 1).  
   *Failure Impact*: Recommendation output is blocked entirely from user presentation if explanation fails.

3. **Portfolio NAV Recalculation Chain**: `CTX-PRC` → `CTX-POS` → `CTX-PORT` → `CTX-RISK`  
   *Significance*: Recalculates user portfolio NAV valuation on market price movement.  
   *Failure Impact*: Portfolio NAV valuation freezes, displaying stale wealth balances.

4. **Regulatory Disclosure Alert Chain**: `CTX-DISCLOSURE` → `CTX-PORT` → `CTX-ALRT` → `CTX-NOTIF`  
   *Significance*: Dispatches sub-60-second alerts when official FRA filings affect user holdings.  
   *Failure Impact*: Users miss price-sensitive corporate disclosure announcements.

5. **Risk Limit Breach Chain**: `CTX-POS` → `CTX-RISK` → `CTX-ALRT` → `CTX-NOTIF`  
   *Significance*: Identifies portfolio concentration or drawdown limit breaches and dispatches emergency alerts.  
   *Failure Impact*: Users are uninformed of critical risk limit breaches.

6. **Corporate Action Adjustment Chain**: `CTX-CORP` → `CTX-SEC` → `CTX-PRC` → `CTX-PORT`  
   *Significance*: Adjusts historical price series and portfolio holdings on ex-dividend / split dates.  
   *Failure Impact*: Unadjusted price spikes cause false chart drops and incorrect NAV drops.

7. **GDR Arbitrage Calculation Chain**: `CTX-PRC` → `CTX-CROSS` → `CTX-FX` → `CTX-ALRT`  
   *Significance*: Calculates price valuation spreads between LSE GDRs and EGX local shares.  
   *Failure Impact*: GDR arbitrage alerts freeze or display un-calibrated spread values.

8. **Fundamental Valuation Chain**: `CTX-DISCLOSURE` → `CTX-FUND` → `CTX-MODEL` → `CTX-INSIGHT`  
   *Significance*: Ingests quarterly financial reports and recalculates DCF fair value models.  
   *Failure Impact*: Valuation models operate on outdated quarterly financial statements.

9. **Pre-Trade Compliance Chain (Phase 2)**: `CTX-POS` → `CTX-RISK` → `CTX-COMP` → `CTX-EXEC`  
   *Significance*: Validates pre-trade position limits and short-selling bans before order routing.  
   *Failure Impact*: Orders violating exchange regulations could be routed to brokers.

10. **Universal Security Access Chain**: `CTX-IDN` → `CTX-ENT` → `CTX-API` → `ALL CONTEXTS`  
    *Significance*: Verifies user authentication tokens and subscription entitlements on every API request.  
    *Failure Impact*: Total platform lockout or unauthorized access to premium capabilities.

---

### 5.6 IMPACT ANALYSIS MATRIX (CRITICAL PATH CASCADES)

| Upstream Failure Event | Immediate Primary Impact | Secondary Cascading Impact | Terminal Business Impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`CTX-PRC` Outage** | `CTX-TECH` calculations halt; `CTX-FUND` recalculation stalls. | `CTX-SIG` turns inactive; `CTX-REC` proposal generation pauses. | `CTX-PORT` NAV valuations freeze; stock details display stale prices. |
| **`CTX-SEC` Outage** | `CTX-MKT` depth validation rejects incoming quotes. | `CTX-PRC` fails to register new ticks; `CTX-CORP` ex-date processing fails. | ALL downstream analytics freeze; new stock listings unresolvable. |
| **`CTX-IDN` Outage** | `CTX-API` gateway blocks all incoming user sessions. | ALL user-facing contexts (`CTX-PORT`, `CTX-ASSIST`, `CTX-ALRT`) unreachable. | Full platform operational outage for all retail and institutional users. |
| **`CTX-COMP` Outage** | `CTX-EXEC` (Phase 2) suspends pre-trade validation. | Order routing engine locks all outbound order queues. | Zero trades routed to exchange; full compliance safety lock triggered. |
| **`CTX-EXEC` Outage (Phase 2)** | Order execution routing fails to transmit fills. | `CTX-POS` fails to update fill lots; `CTX-PORT` position holdings freeze. | Executed orders un-reflected in portfolio; manual trade reconciliation required. |

## SECTION 6 — CONTEXT EVOLUTION ROADMAP
## القسم 6 — خريطة طريق تطور السياقات

Tradeora's architecture evolves across **3 strategic expansion phases** aligned with market launch milestones:

---

### 6.1 PHASE 1 — EGX LAUNCH CONTEXT SET (32 ACTIVE CONTEXTS)

Phase 1 establishes full coverage of the **Egyptian Exchange (EGX)** market ecosystem.

#### Active Contexts & Minimum Capabilities
- **Market Data Cluster**: `CTX-EXCH`, `CTX-CAL`, `CTX-SES`, `CTX-SEC`, `CTX-MKT`, `CTX-PRC`, `CTX-CORP`, `CTX-STR` (Full real-time quote streaming, Level-2 depth, EGX session control, corporate action adjustments).
- **Research Cluster**: `CTX-FUND`, `CTX-TECH`, `CTX-MAC`, `CTX-QUANT`, `CTX-SENT` (Arabic financial accounting, technical indicators, CBE macro series, factor ranking, news sentiment).
- **AI Intelligence Cluster**: `CTX-REC`, `CTX-EXPL`, `CTX-CONF`, `CTX-SIG`, `CTX-NLQ`, `CTX-ASSIST`, `CTX-RAG` (Explainable investment proposals, causal tree explanations, Arabic NLP copilot).
- **Portfolio Cluster**: `CTX-PORT`, `CTX-POS`, `CTX-PERF`, `CTX-FX`, `CTX-WATCH`, `CTX-SCRN`, `CTX-TAX` (EGP NAV accounting, T+2 position lot keeping, performance attribution, tax lot capital gains).
- **Risk & Compliance Cluster**: `CTX-RISK`, `CTX-COMP`, `CTX-AUD` (VaR limit checks, Egyptian FRA compliance rules, 5-year audit trail logging).
- **Platform Infrastructure**: `CTX-IDN`, `CTX-ENT`, `CTX-ALRT`, `CTX-NOTIF`, `CTX-API`, `CTX-DATA`, `CTX-OBS`, `CTX-SEC-INFRA`, `CTX-CACHE`, `CTX-MEDIA`, `CTX-CROSS`, `CTX-DISCLOSURE` (OAuth identity, entitlement guards, multi-channel notifications, sub-60s regulatory disclosure indexing).

---

### 6.2 PHASE 2 — MENA REGIONAL EXPANSION

Phase 2 expands platform coverage to Saudi Tadawul (TASI), UAE (ADX, DFM), Kuwait (BK), and Qatar (QSE) financial markets.

#### New & Expanded Contexts
- **`CTX-EXEC` (Order Routing & Execution)**: Activated for Phase 2 smart order routing to licensed regional brokers under FRA/SCA/CMA regulatory oversight.
- **`CTX-FX` Expansion**: Adds GCC currency cross rates (SAR, AED, KWD, QAR) with real-time EGP peg/devaluation handling.
- **`CTX-CAL` / `CTX-SES` Expansion**: Multi-calendar engine supporting Sunday–Thursday GCC trading schedules alongside Friday–Saturday weekend rules.
- **`CTX-DISCLOSURE` Expansion**: Direct scraper adapters for Saudi Tadawul (Tadawulaty) and UAE SCA regulatory disclosure portals.

---

### 6.3 PHASE 3 — GLOBAL MULTI-ASSET SCALE

Phase 3 introduces US Equities (NYSE, NASDAQ), European Markets (LSE, XETRA), and Digital Assets.

#### Future Context Activation
- **`CTX-CRYPTO` (Digital Assets & Crypto Analytics)**: Cryptographic token analytics, spot price aggregation, and chain indexer integration.
- **`CTX-GLOBAL` (Global Multi-Currency Execution)**: International multi-currency execution routing across US and European exchanges.
- **`CTX-PORT` Global Wealth Expansion**: Multi-asset wealth management, institutional custody integration, and cross-border inheritance tax lot tracking.

## SECTION 7 — CONSISTENCY AND AUTONOMY RULES
## القسم 7 — قواعد الاتساق والاستقلالية

---

### 7.1 CONSISTENCY MODEL BY CONTEXT CLUSTER

Tradeora enforces a hybrid consistency model tailored to domain criticality:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                          TRADEORA CONSISTENCY MODEL                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 1. STRONG CONSISTENCY REQUIRED (Immediate Transactional Consistency)        │
│    - CTX-POS (Position Keeping): Holding quantities cannot be negative.     │
│    - CTX-PORT (Portfolio NAV): Cash & ledger balance must reconcile.        │
│    - CTX-COMP (Compliance Rules): Regulatory bans enforced immediately.     │
│    - CTX-AUD (Audit Logging): Audit entries append-only, zero loss.        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 2. EVENTUAL CONSISTENCY ACCEPTABLE (Sub-Second Asynchronous Convergence)    │
│    - CTX-PRC (Price Stream Processing): Ticks converge within < 10ms.       │
│    - CTX-TECH (Technical Analysis): Indicators re-compute on candle close.  │
│    - CTX-SIG / CTX-REC (AI Engine): Signal proposals update asynchronously. │
│    - CTX-PERF (Performance Attribution): Daily TWR returns calculate post-close.│
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 3. INDEPENDENT CONSISTENCY (Self-Contained Autonomous State)                │
│    - CTX-WATCH (Watchlists): User list modifications self-contained.        │
│    - CTX-COMM (Community Posts): User social posts independent.             │
│    - CTX-FEEDBACK (User NPS): Survey analytics fully self-contained.        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 7.2 CONTEXT AUTONOMY LEVELS

- **FULLY AUTONOMOUS**: Context can execute core business logic using locally cached read projections without active upstream availability (`CTX-TECH`, `CTX-QUANT`, `CTX-MODEL`, `CTX-WATCH`).
- **CONDITIONALLY AUTONOMOUS**: Context continues partial read-only operations when upstream is unavailable, but pauses state-changing updates (`CTX-PORT`, `CTX-RISK`, `CTX-SIG`, `CTX-REC`).
- **DEPENDENT**: Context cannot function if primary upstream context is offline (`CTX-PRC` dependent on `CTX-MKT`; `CTX-API` dependent on `CTX-IDN`).

---

### 7.3 FAILURE ISOLATION & BLAST RADIUS RULES

1. **`CTX-PRC` Failure Blast Radius**: If price stream processing fails, live pricing displays freeze across UI. **Failure Isolation**: `CTX-PORT` continues displaying last-known closing NAV; `CTX-POS` permits manual lot viewing; `CTX-COMP` retains pre-market compliance rules.
2. **`CTX-SIG` Failure Blast Radius**: If quantitative signal engine fails, automated signals pause. **Failure Isolation**: `CTX-PORT` continues portfolio accounting; `CTX-PRC` continues live quote streaming; `CTX-ASSIST` falls back to general financial knowledge Q&A.
3. **`CTX-DISCLOSURE` Failure Blast Radius**: If disclosure ingestion fails, new regulatory filings pause. **Failure Isolation**: Market quote streams (`CTX-PRC`), historical financial statements (`CTX-FUND`), and position holdings (`CTX-PORT`) remain 100% operational.

### 8.3 CONTEXT BOUNDARY IMMUTABILITY RULE

2. Documentation in `docs/BOUNDED_CONTEXT_MAP.md` MUST be updated and approved **BEFORE any code implementation changes occur**.
3. Any boundary modification altering event payload contracts or object ownership is classified as a **Major Architectural Change** requiring full regression testing.

## SECTION 9 — AI CONTEXT GOVERNANCE
## القسم 9 — حوكمة سياقات الذكاء الاصطناعي

Dedicated architectural governance rules for the 7 AI Intelligence Contexts (`CTX-SIG`, `CTX-REC`, `CTX-EXPL`, `CTX-CONF`, `CTX-NLQ`, `CTX-ASSIST`, `CTX-RAG`):

---

### 9.1 AI CONTEXT SPECIAL RULES

1. **Mandatory Source Confidence Flag**: All data outputs generated by AI contexts MUST carry explicit source metadata: `SourceConfidence: AI_GENERATED`.
2. **Strict Non-Custodial Operation**: AI contexts operate exclusively in non-custodial advisory mode. **Zero autonomous trade execution** is permitted without explicit, manual human confirmation (Principle 3.2 & Rule 1).
3. **Prohibition of Data Blending**: `AI_GENERATED` inferences MUST NEVER be presented as `OFFICIAL_EXCHANGE` data without clear confidence disclosures.
4. **Zero-Hallucination Citation Mandate**: Every AI financial insight or narrative MUST cite verified primary source documents ingested by `CTX-FUND` or `CTX-DISCLOSURE` (Principle 3.1).

---

### 9.2 MANDATORY AI EXPLAINABILITY CHAIN

The following explainability chain is **NON-NEGOTIABLE** across the enterprise platform:

$$\text{Quantitative Signal (\texttt{CTX-SIG})} \longrightarrow \text{Recommendation Proposal (\texttt{CTX-REC})} \longrightarrow \text{Causal Explanation (\texttt{CTX-EXPL})} \longrightarrow \text{User Presentation (\texttt{CTX-UI})}$$

> [!CAUTION]
> **CONSTITUTIONAL VIOLATION WARNING:**  
> A recommendation proposal generated by `CTX-REC` that lacks a corresponding causal tree explanation from `CTX-EXPL` is a **DIRECT CONSTITUTIONAL VIOLATION** (Principle 3.1 & Rule 1). The API Gateway and User Interface layers are hard-programmed to **REJECT AND DROP** any recommendation proposal missing its explainability payload.

---

### 9.3 AI GOVERNANCE EVENTS & MANDATORY AUDIT RETENTION

| Event ID | AI Governance Event Name | Mandatory Audit Retention Period | Business Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AI-001` | `AI_RECOMMENDATION_GENERATED` | 5 Years (Permanent FRA Audit) | Proves non-custodial advisory lineage for regulatory compliance. |
| `AI-002` | `AI_CAUSAL_EXPLANATION_ATTACHED` | 5 Years (Permanent FRA Audit) | Verifies explainability compliance for generated recommendations. |
| `AI-003` | `AI_MODEL_RECALIBRATED` | 5 Years (Permanent FRA Audit) | Records quantitative model weight recalibrations and out-of-sample tests. |

| `AI-005` | `AI_CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATED` | 3 Years (Platform Quality Log) | Records probability calibration adjustments across market regimes. |

This document (`docs/BOUNDED_CONTEXT_MAP.md`) is subordinate strictly to `docs/PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md` (Supreme Authority).
